purpose: Produce attested, content-addressed build provenance for the already-qualified blst v0.3.17 native boundary so a FUTURE governed dependency-admission decision is evidence-backed. This slice performs no admission itself.

upstream_source_tree_digest_contract.authority: pinned git object inventory, never an OS-materialised checkout
binds: blob sha256 of exact git cat-file bytes
upstream_source_tree_digest_contract.submodule_entries: bound as submodule:<oid>; submodules have no content in this repository
upstream_source_tree_digest_contract.rationale: git object bytes are unaffected by checkout line-ending or filesystem presentation, so Windows and Linux runners agree

build_recipe_digest_contract.rationale: the recipe digest identifies the recipe, not one execution of it, and can never contain its own output

pinned_actions.policy: full immutable commit SHAs only; moving tags are forbidden in uses:

credential_isolation_contract.rationale: GitHub exposes the OIDC token at JOB scope, and a pull request controls its own workflow DEFINITION. Isolating the credential into a separate job in the same pull-request-triggered workflow was therefore insufficient: the pull request still authored the file that granted the capability. Privileged execution must be anchored to the default branch.

trusted_workflow.checks_out: github.event.workflow_run.head_sha, proven to be on the default branch
trusted_workflow.source_run_policy: exactly github.event.workflow_run.id; no operator-supplied run id, no fork source, no non-main branch, no non-workflow_dispatch event

immutable_artifact_boundary.github_token_rationale: the pinned action documents that omitting github-token downloads from the current repository and the current workflow run, so no additional permission is required

approved_qualification_workflow_digest.rationale: a future pull request could otherwise change qualification semantics and ship a receipt claiming PASS; the trusted gate requires the qualification workflow blob at the source head to equal a digest approved on the default branch, and fails closed otherwise

credential_isolation_contract.proves: credential isolation and default-branch anchoring of the attestation capability, plus immutable-artifact identity between qualification and attestation
credential_isolation_contract.does_not_prove: that the qualification build code itself is non-malicious, nor that the build is bit-for-bit reproducible

attestation_contract.mode_selection: explicit predicate-type and predicate-path; SLSA build provenance is NOT claimed because the attesting workflow did not build the binary
attestation_contract.subject_binding_rationale: the action signs exactly the digests the trusted gate validated, rather than independently re-resolving a mutable path after validation
attestation_contract.create_storage_record_note: the pinned action documents that create-storage-record requires push-to-registry=true; this workflow pushes to no registry and sets it false explicitly
attestation_contract.required_permissions_scope: granted ONLY on the attest-trusted-evidence job of the default-branch-anchored trusted workflow, never in the pull-request-triggered qualification workflow at any scope
attestation_contract.verification_authority: GitHub cryptographic attestation verification (gh attestation verify), never a workflow log string

mandatory_sequence: STAGE A build job: checkout exact source head
STAGE A: prove exact source head
STAGE A: checkout exact pinned blst commit and prove upstream identity
STAGE A: build native blst and shim
STAGE A: generate canonical provenance manifest
STAGE A: upload immutable candidate artifact (binary + manifest only)
IMMUTABILITY BOUNDARY: artifact uploaded once, overwrite false, never re-uploaded
STAGE B qualify job: fresh-download that exact artifact by artifact id
STAGE B: enumerate exactly two files and fail closed on any third
STAGE B: recompute binary and manifest digests and require manifest agreement
STAGE B: require manifest source_head_sha equals the qualification head
STAGE B: require all protected flags false
STAGE B: Lane A structural negatives against the DOWNLOADED binary
STAGE B: Lane A upstream subgroup vectors
STAGE B: Lane A G1 X=0 decode-time subgroup edge
STAGE B: Lane B canonical root binding and real Quicknet verify
STAGE B: emit qualification receipt and upload it separately
MERGE BOUNDARY: no privileged execution may occur before merge
STAGE C default branch only: workflow_run consumes the exact completed main run
STAGE C: trusted gate independently revalidates run, jobs, artifacts and digests
STAGE C: attest the validated checksums
ordering_contract.attestation_requires_qualification_pass_: the trusted gate requires source run conclusion success and every one of the four expected qualification jobs to have succeeded
ordering_contract.same_binary_throughout_note: REMOVED as overstated. Same-job path identity proves nothing about bytes a concurrent process could mutate. The real property is that the GitHub artifact is immutable and qualification consumes a fresh download of it, so the qualified bytes and the attested bytes are the same artifact content, independently re-digested at every stage.

distinct_digests.note: these four digests are different objects and must never be conflated
distinct_digests.artifact_archive_digest: sha256 of the GitHub artifact ZIP, reported by the artifact service and by upload-artifact's artifact-digest output
distinct_digests.binary_digest: sha256 of the native shim bytes inside the artifact
distinct_digests.manifest_digest: sha256 of the canonical provenance manifest bytes inside the artifact
distinct_digests.qualification_receipt_digest: sha256 of the receipt JSON, carried in a separate artifact

linux.evidence: pinned build.sh adds -D__ADX__ only when the BUILD HOST /proc/cpuinfo reports adx, which would be host-specialised; pinned README documents passing -D__BLST_PORTABLE__ on the build.sh command line; build.sh forwards unrecognised -* options into cflags; src/vect.h lines 72 and 144 and src/sha256.h gate the ADX and SHA specialisations on !defined(__BLST_PORTABLE__)

windows.evidence: pinned build.bat performs NO host CPU feature detection, never defines __ADX__, and passes no /arch: flag, so src/vect.h never aliases to the mulx_/sqrx_/ctx_ specialisations and MSVC targets baseline x86-64
windows.caveat: no portable flag exists for build.bat and none was invented; the claim is that the recipe is not specialised to the build host, established from pinned source. Instruction-level disassembly of the emitted binary was not performed.

execution_proofs.note: committed source may never self-promote execution proof; runtime GitHub evidence is authoritative. Privileged attestation intentionally cannot run before merge because its workflow definition must first exist on the default branch.

superseded_attestations.note: attestations produced by the pre-repair pull-request workflow must never be cited as merge evidence for the repaired architecture
